paraphrase: Proposes that receipts should be produced by the operation itself, not reconstructed afterwards. The receipt gets expensive when it tries to reconstruct state after the fact. A cheaper architecture makes the operation emit: requested action, admitted operation class, result, and a forward pointer.

claims.text: Receipts are cheaper when the operation produces them natively rather than reconstructing state after the fact
A receipt should contain: requested action, admitted operation class, result, forward pointer

evaluation.notes: Concrete field proposal. Architecture principle: produce-receipt-at-operation-time.
